expectation: Membrane-localised CD3 on T cells only: discrete ring-like cells, a minority of the tissue (sparse to dense), scattered singly in stroma and clustered in lymphoid or tumour-infiltrating aggregates, absent from epithelium and tumour nests.
observed: A: many small discrete yellow cells; some tiles are sparse and others hold dense aggregates, while large nucleus-rich zones stay empty. B/C: nucleus-rich tissue is mostly CD3-negative, with a few small bright clusters. D: bright cells with a blotchy, pixelated texture. E: CD3 is dense in the CD4-rich field; the merge shows many white (CD3+CD4+) cells beside green-only and magenta-only cells.
why: CD3 marks a distinct subset of cells in patchy aggregates and not in all nucleated tissue, and in E it sits on a subset of CD4 cells.
notes: CD3 is patchy, concentrated in infiltrate-like aggregates, and absent from large nucleated areas. In E it overlaps CD4 (white), with CD3-only cells (likely CD8) and CD4-only cells (likely myeloid) as expected.
